preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n or pi == -1 for pi in p)
preconditions.description: Each immediate manager pi is either -1 (no manager) or a valid employee number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(pi != i for i, pi in enumerate(p, start=1))
preconditions.description: No employee is their own immediate manager.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of groups is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(path) for path in all_paths) if all_paths else 1
postconditions.description: The minimum number of groups is the length of the longest path in the managerial hierarchy.
